Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the correctly gathered data during synthesis. Although earlier steps established that Giuliano Carnimeo (Poker in Bed) died in 2016 and Roberto Rossellini (The Machine to Kill Bad People) died in 1977, the Planner concluded that Poker in Bed had the director who died earlier and even misattributed Rossellini to Poker in Bed. This reversed both the film-director association and the chronological comparison, leading to an incorrect final answer.
